payload.core_mechanism_summary: DP with state (position, bitmask of used digits) and precomputed jump indices to add exactly k copies of a digit.
payload.rationale: Solution iteratively builds DP over positions and masks, typical of dp_bitmask. It uses a bitmask to track which digits have been taken and transitions by taking val or val+1 copies of an unused digit, leveraging precomputed next occurrence arrays.
